stem.text: The diagram shows the mass spectrum of a sample of chlorine. Peaks $V$, $W$, $X$, $Y$ and $Z$ are labelled.

stem.alt: Mass spectrum (relative intensity 0 to 100 against m/e 30 to 80) with peaks labelled V, W, X, Y and Z: V near m/e 35 and X near m/e 70 are the tallest, W near 37, Y near 72 and Z near 74 are smaller.

stem.text: Which statements about this spectrum are correct?

items: The relative atomic mass of chlorine can be calculated from the abundances and $m/e$ values of 2 of the 5 peaks.
37.0g of the species responsible for peak $Z$ contains $3.011 \times 10^{23}$ molecules.
The relative molecular mass of chlorine can be calculated from the abundances and $m/e$ values of peaks $X$, $Y$ and $Z$.
